tokens.{heading_2}: Our Micro-CNC Process: From Concept to Finished Part
tokens.{body_1}: A clear engineering workflow from first brief through material selection, DFM review, fabrication, validation, and delivery.
tokens.{body_2}: Share your drawing, CAD file, application goal, tolerance needs, or early-stage project requirements.
tokens.{body_3}: Use your own material or source precision metals, polymers, ceramics, and specialist grades through Goodfellow.
tokens.{body_4}: Collaborative DFM review to align geometry, material, tolerances, process route, and manufacturability.
tokens.{body_5}: Precision CNC or hybrid fabrication with inspection, measurement, and optional validation support available.
tokens.{body_6}: Move from prototype into repeat production with documented outputs, traceability, and scale-up support.
tokens.{body_7}: ●  Supported by the Goodfellow Group’s integrated material, fabrication, and testing capabilities.
